text: Customer complaint: was told a rival NBFC offers zero down payment, asked why we don't match it.
Customer unable to reach showroom due to flooded access road, requested reschedule.
Loan application rejected; customer asked why the credit score requirement increased.
Delay in follow-up call after initial enquiry, customer went ahead with a different lender.
Complaint about slow processing time attributed to reduced staff at branch.
Minor query about EMI schedule, resolved same day.
Customer asked about the new interest rate after hearing about the RBI repo rate hike.
Customer mentioned competitor's advertisement offering no down payment this month.
Follow-up delayed again, customer frustrated with response time.
